(rule!
 (let ((dummy 0))
   (define portal-colors
     (filter (lambda (color) (= (length (find-color g color)) 2))
             (list 4 5 6)))
   (define (portal-span color)
     (let* ((points (find-color g color))
            (a (first points))
            (b (second points)))
       (+ (abs (- (first a) (first b)))
          (abs (- (second a) (second b))))))
   (define active-color
     (if (empty? portal-colors)
         0
         (for/fold ((best (first portal-colors)))
                   ((color (in-list (rest portal-colors))))
           (if (> (portal-span color) (portal-span best)) color best))))
   (define start (first (find-color g 2)))
   (define goal (first (find-color g 3)))
   (define (portal-exit p)
     (let ((v (at g (first p) (second p))))
       (if (= v active-color)
           (let ((others (filter (lambda (q) (not (equal? q p)))
                                 (find-color g v))))
             (if (empty? others) p (first others)))
           p)))
   (define queue (list start))
   (define prev (make-hash))
   (hash-set! prev start #f)
   (define (search)
     (unless (or (empty? queue) (hash-has-key? prev goal))
       (define cur (first queue))
       (set! queue (rest queue))
       (for ((d (in-list cardinal-deltas)))
         (define nr (+ (first cur) (first d)))
         (define nc (+ (second cur) (second d)))
         (when (and (in-bounds? nr nc (rows g) (cols g))
                    (not (= (at g nr nc) 8)))
           (define nxt (portal-exit (list nr nc)))
           (when (not (hash-has-key? prev nxt))
             (hash-set! prev nxt cur)
             (set! queue (append queue (list nxt))))))
       (search)))
   (search)
   (if (not (hash-has-key? prev goal))
       g
       (let ((path (let rebuild ((cur goal) (acc (list)))
                     (if (eq? cur #f)
                         acc
                         (rebuild (hash-ref prev cur #f) (cons cur acc))))))
         (for/fold ((out g)) ((p (in-list path)))
           (if (= (at out (first p) (second p)) 0)
               (set-cell out (first p) (second p) 7)
               out))))))
